welcome.title: Welcome to GeoAgent
welcome.body: This is a conversation-driven GIS workbench: describe what you want in natural language to run analysis, build maps and export. Take 60 seconds to learn the key entry points (press Esc anytime to skip; replay later from Settings).

modes.title: Three work modes
modes.body: The mode switch at the bottom left toggles Explore / Analyze / Compose — each mode keeps only the relevant tabs: Explore (Chat · Layers · Data), Analyze (Analysis · Results), Compose (Components · Layout).

chat.title: Chat is the main entry
chat.body: Describe your analysis goal in the chat panel (e.g. "run a hotspot analysis on this map"), and the Agent will plan the tool chain and land the results on the map.

rail.title: Rail panels
rail.body: The left rail gathers 10 panels: Chat, Project, Data, Layers, Components, Analysis, Tasks, Results, Layout. Click the active tab again to collapse the panel.

palette.title: Command palette (Ctrl+K)
palette.body: Every action is one palette away: switch panels, export, theme… Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on mac) anytime; press ? for the shortcut overview.

queryConsole.title: Advanced query console
queryConsole.body: Know SQL / filter expressions? Search "query console" in the command palette or enter from the top right of the data panel: run filter queries on catalog datasets, inspect pushdown plans, and send results to the map in one click.

search.title: Cross-session search
search.body: Search "cross-session search" in the command palette: full-text search (messages / artifacts / layer names) across recent sessions, with hits that jump straight back to the matching message.

history.title: Operation history & undo
history.body: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z to undo and redo, each step confirmed by a toast; search "operation history" in the command palette to view the timeline, trace by layer, and roll back multiple steps at once.

mapTools.title: Map tools
mapTools.body: Map toolbar: zoom (+/−), measure distance (d), measure area (a), box select (b), 3D toggle (3); basemap and compare mode live in the top bar.

done.title: Start exploring
done.body: Hint cards will introduce advanced tricks over time (template library, compare mode, ref coupons…); all of them can be reset or replayed from Settings → System.

hints.refCoupon: Big results won't blow up the chat: the ref coupon mechanism keeps large data in the session warehouse, and layers and charts are fetched on demand.
hints.commandPalette: The Ctrl+K command palette reaches any panel or export action — give it a try.
hints.queryConsole: Know SQL? The "query console" supports filter expressions, pushdown plan disclosure and one-click results on the map.
hints.crossSearch: "Cross-session search" full-text searches messages and artifacts from the 20 most recent sessions, and jumps straight to a hit.
hints.comparison: Compare mode (split / swipe) can be enabled from the top bar to visually compare two map versions.
hints.templates: The "Templates" entry at the bottom left ships a cartography template library — apply publication-grade styles in one click.
hints.undoHistory: The "operation history" panel traces style / visibility / reorder per layer and rolls back multiple steps at once.
hints.storyShare: A session can generate a StoryMap narrative page: chapter arrangement, chart playback, share cards and narrative PDF export.
